[P2] QWEN38-FULLTASK-01: Live full-task results of 2026-09-26 after the audit. qwen3-coder:30b run audit-20260926c: VERIFIED, 8/8 milestones, 37/50 steps, about 53 min, median prompt eval 5.0 s and median step 21 s (qwen3.8 on 2026-09-25: 57.9 s and 128 s); installs approved, build fixed after 3 failures (snapshot %USERPROFILE%\OnlyRag-Live\snapshots\*audit-20260926c*). Run audit-20260926b (before the stall fix) closed on transport_budget: Ollama sends nothing while a tool call is generated and a 1193-token write at 3.95 tok/s hit the fixed 5-minute stall limit twice (now speed-based). qwen3.8:27b: run audit-20260926 was stopped by the assistant at step 5 to fix the transcript; step 1-2 telemetry showed num_ctx 65536, 83% CPU / 17% GPU, a full 37 s prompt re-evaluation at step 2 and 1092 thinking tokens at about 2.85 tok/s (6.4 min per turn with the model's default 'medium' thinking). Run audit-20260926b with the append-only transcript was stopped at the user's request before any telemetry. Next: rerun qwen3.8 with a unique ONLYRAG_LIVE_RUN, check per-turn promptEvalDurationMs from step 2 on; if misses persist, compare with modelThinkingPreferences['qwen3.8:27b']='low' or false and with thinking stripped from history. Workspaces fulltask_qwen3-coder-30b-audit-20260926, -audit-20260926b, -audit-20260926c and fulltask_qwen3-8-27b-audit-20260926, -audit-20260926b are disposable after their snapshots.

[P2] AGENT-AUDIT-20260926-RESIDUALS-01: The coding-agent audit of 2026-09-26 (docs/coding-agent-audit-2026-09-26.md) left these open. (1) PersistentPowerShellSession never tracks the shell's real cwd, so structuredCommandSafety resolves relative paths against the workspace root: 'cd ..' from a subfolder is refused (conservative) and paths after a cd are judged from the root. (2) normalizePowerShellCommand rewrites 'npx X' to 'npx -y X', and shellCommandHasEgress does not treat a bare npx of a package missing from node_modules/.bin as network use: npx can install an unrelated package without consent. (3) No background-process tool or port probe for dev servers; blocked servers still end as a refused command. (4) replace_file_content and multi_replace_file_content return no compact diff and no typecheck feedback, unlike write_file, and the TypeScript check runs synchronously on the Electron main thread. (5) git_commit uses a 15 s timeout (pre-commit hooks), git_diff omits untracked files the agent created, approval cards label web_search/fetch as write_file, and validate_visual_artifact reports a page load failure as 'Playwright runtime unavailable'.

[P2] AGENT-LEGACY-TEXT-PATH-01: Native /api/chat is the only agent path since the audit of 2026-09-26, but every turn still builds the legacy single-string turnPrompt (agentPromptAssembler + HeuristicContextCompactor), computes decideContextReuse (ollamaContextCacheManager) and keeps the /api/generate branch of AgentStreamTransport.streamCompletion, the text tool catalogue and parseAgentToolCall. They only feed the debug log now. Remove them with their tests after confirming no caller outside the native path, and log the real chat messages instead.

[P2] AGENT-DIRECTIVE-AUTHORITY-02: The audit of 2026-09-26 made planDirectiveArbiter policy-aware, filtered policy-refused tools from the catalogue and turned the version-behind and milestone-redelivery orders into notes, but other tool-result producers still end with 'Directives: MUST' blocks (compilerDiagnosticDirective, testFailureDiagnostic, moduleResolutionDiagnostic, npmVersionNotFound, npmResolutionConflict, installVersionDowngrade, redundantWriteDetector, loopDetector interventions). Convert them to facts the arbiter consumes, add an invariant test that no two orders can reach one turn, and review the guards that never fired in 67 live snapshots for removal.

[P3] AGENT-SAMPLING-UI-01: settings.modelSamplingOverrides (temperature, top_p, top_k, min_p, repeat_penalty, presence_penalty, num_thread per model) is validated and applied by the agent since 2026-09-26 but has no Settings UI; users can only set it in settings.json.

[P3] AGENT-FOLLOWUP-STATE-01: A follow-up run in the same conversation restores the previous chatMessages after the new task and the pinned runtime profile (model and num_ctx) overrides current settings (agentOrchestratorSessionContext.ts). Decide whether a follow-up keeps the transcript, and let a changed model or context setting take effect.

[P3] I18N-MAIN-MESSAGES-01: agent:log supports structured localized keys from shared/domain/agent/agentMainText.ts, with Italian fallback text. Closure, diagnostics, plan, loop, circuit-breaker, prompt assembly and response interpretation messages were migrated previously. On 2026-09-25 ToolExecutionResult gained a validated localized.message field, forwarded by agentOrchestratorToolResultProcessor without parsing logMessage; the main run_command and run_tests results now use it. Remaining: other tool result producers (filesystem, web, Git, recovery, diagnostics and process preconditions), fixed-language Main emitLog and error strings in the files named in earlier revisions, sessionDebtTracker markdown, and Sidecar chunk prefix [Documento: ... | Sezione: ...] (requires re-index migration). Preserve parsed prefixes Task Finished:, Consulting LLM (<model>), the AI Agent Question marker and Loop banners. Verification on 2026-09-25: npm run typecheck, npm run build, npm run quality:static, npm run docs:check and 99 targeted Vitest tests passed; the full fast suite was not rerun after these edits. Next session: migrate other tool result producers through localized.message, then the remaining Main strings; do not infer keys from English logMessage.
